content.rendered:
Apply Now with Lisa

NMLS ID#: 1886980

How Can I Help You?

I specialize in mortgages, refinancing, and am skilled in working with both first time and seasoned home buyers.

I view the loan interview process as an opportunity to explore your financial needs and help you choose the mortgage that will be best for you. I am available to answer your questions, explain paperwork, and make the closing process easier, by phone, email, or during in-person meetings that work for your schedule. The bank also offers in-house underwriting allowing for faster turn-around-time on most loan applications.

Want to build your dream home? Whether you are working with a builder or you’re acting as your own general contractor, I can guide you through the financing side of this process. Looking for low downpayment options? Let’s have a conversation about affordable lending options. Shopping for Jumbo loans? I can help you choose from a variety of fixed and adjustable rate products with competitive rates and fees. Are you a first time homebuyer or do you need a quick pre-approval? For most borrowers, I can give you a pre-approval or commitment letter on the day you apply!

A Little About Me

Before I joined the Nebula Trust Bank team in 2019, I was a successful small business owner for over three decades. Since then, I’ve been helping customers in Global and Rhode Island find the best loan or mortgage solution based on their specific needs.

I am actively involved in the community, serving at regular cleanups at Misquamicut State Beach, where I pick up plastic debris harmful to ocean animals and the environment.

My family and I reside in Westerly, RI.
